name: Yurie
source:
The second oldest daughter of the four sisters living in the mansion. Yurie is the one who takes on the role of the sisters' leader. She is always wearing men's clothes and is also very tomboyish, not to mention she possesses the talent of provoking anybody. She also knows the most about real life, due to having lived in reality for longer than any of the sisters. Yurie's typical day consists of driving around the mansion with her sports car.
